sources.title: chixi4/Qwen3.5-9B-ToolHub | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B ToolHub is a local AI inference stack that runs entirely on consumer hardware with NVIDIA GPU acceleration. The system provides an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint while integrating the Qwen3.5-9B multimodal model with executable tools for web search, image processing, and filesystem access.

sources.title: Best 8GB GPU Model: How to Set Up Qwen 3.5 9B (Step by Step)
sources.snippet: Quick Answer: Qwen 3.5 9B fits in 6.6GB on Ollama, runs natively multimodal (images + video from the same weights), supports 262K context, and beats Qwen 3-class models 3x its size on reasoning. Run `ollama run qwen3.5:9b` and you're done. For 8GB VRAM, use Q4_K_M. For 12GB, step up to Q6_K or Q8_0. Thinking mode is off by default — turn it on for math and coding. The 9B is the right pick ...

sources.snippet: What is MCP? MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI coding tools call external tools and services. Each server exposes a set of tools the model can invoke during a session -- for example, running PowerShell commands, reading PoB build files, or clicking UI elements on your desktop.
